title: Part Thirteen: The Ledger: Gaza, the West Bank and Lebanon

sections.brief: Gaza: 7 Oct 2023 toll (1,195/815, 251 hostages); earlier rounds 2008-09, 2014, 2021 by source; the dead and wounded by counting body (MoH 74,382 to 12 Oct 2026, 175,142 injured; identified dead by children/women/elderly; COI children; Lancet; IDF database; 474 soldiers); aid, health, civil-defence and media workers; housing, schools, water, cropland, shelter, famine; Israel's stated positions; destabilisation and the 65-70% line as of Oct 2026; expansion as labelled argument. Figure: stats

West Bank: baseline 2000-2022 (B'Tselem, Oxfam); deaths since 2023 by three counts not merged (OHCHR 1,001/213 children; Oxfam 1,244/268; OCHA 2025 and Jan 2025-Aug 2026); Israelis killed; Iron Wall and the camps (UNRWA 34,176), settler attacks, demolitions (2,702), displacement (41,951; ~46,000); Israel's stated reasons; PA fiscal collapse and settlement growth as of Oct 2026; link to the documented programme in Part Six. Figure: compare

Lebanon: 1982 and 2006 tolls in brief; 8 Oct 2023 support front (ACLED counts, Majdal Shams, 60,000 Israelis displaced); 2023-24 toll (4,047 incl. 790 women, 316 children; Alma 45+83); World Bank damage; truce deaths; 2026 war (Hezbollah fire 2 Mar, Kiryat Shmona warning, 4,387 killed, 1.2m displaced, Israel's 39+3), UNDP-CNRS building damage, Yaroun; destabilisation, Yellow Line, UNIFIL end, Tampa talks 20 Oct 2026; expansion as labelled argument. Figure: stats
